about_disclaimer: Banange shows community reports of power outages. It is not official data from UEDCL or any utility, and should not be used in emergencies.
about_privacy: We round your location to about 500 m. We don't ask for your name, phone or email, and we don't store your IP address. To stop spam we keep an anonymous device code that can't be traced back to you.
